title: Recommended practice for safeguarding against warpage and distortion of hot-dipped galvanized articles
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard recommends the methods to be adopted for safeguarding against warpage and distortion during hot dip galvanizing of steel assemblies.
clause_3_terminology: Recommended practice for safeguarding against warpage and distortion of hot
Recommended practice for safeguarding against warpage and distortion of hot-dipped galvanized articles

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
